# Wiki.js, built from this fork.
#
# Upstream's own build image (dev/build/Dockerfile) with two changes, both
# of which the official CI does too and a plain `docker build` does not:
#
#   * the version is stamped in. The source says 2.0.0 because official
#     builds overwrite it; left alone, Admin > System Info would report a
#     version that does not exist.
#   * `dev` is turned off. `WIKI.devMode` comes from that field
#     (server/core/config.js), and with it on the wiki runs as a
#     development build.
#
# Build from the repository root:
#   docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.wiki -t wiki-rag/wiki:<tag> .

# ====================
# --- Build Assets ---
# ====================
FROM node:24-alpine AS assets

RUN apk add yarn g++ make cmake python3 --no-cache

WORKDIR /wiki

COPY ./client ./client
COPY ./dev ./dev
COPY ./patches ./patches
COPY ./package.json ./package.json
COPY ./.babelrc ./.babelrc
COPY ./.eslintignore ./.eslintignore
COPY ./.eslintrc.yml ./.eslintrc.yml

# The version this build reports. The default is the upstream tag this
# branch is based on; see CLAUDE.md on 2.5.316 and 2.5.317, which are not
# tagged upstream and add no database changes.
ARG WIKI_VERSION=2.5.315
# What it was built from, for the image label only. Not shown in the wiki.
ARG WIKI_BUILD=unknown

# Same edit the official workflow makes with jq, without adding jq.
RUN node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); p.version=process.env.WIKI_VERSION; p.dev=false; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2))" \
  && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log('building version', p.version, 'dev =', p.dev)"

RUN yarn cache clean
RUN yarn --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive
RUN yarn build
RUN rm -rf /wiki/node_modules
RUN yarn --production --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive
RUN yarn patch-package

# ===============
# --- Release ---
# ===============
FROM node:24-alpine

ARG WIKI_VERSION=2.5.315
ARG WIKI_BUILD=unknown
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="Wiki.js with the AI assistant"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.version="${WIKI_VERSION}"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision="${WIKI_BUILD}"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/requarks/wiki"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.licenses="AGPL-3.0-only"

RUN apk add bash curl git openssh gnupg sqlite --no-cache && \
    mkdir -p /wiki && \
    mkdir -p /logs && \
    mkdir -p /wiki/data/content && \
    chown -R node:node /wiki /logs

WORKDIR /wiki

COPY --chown=node:node --from=assets /wiki/assets ./assets
COPY --chown=node:node --from=assets /wiki/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --chown=node:node ./server ./server
COPY --chown=node:node --from=assets /wiki/server/views ./server/views
COPY --chown=node:node ./dev/build/config.yml ./config.yml
# The stamped one, not the one in the repository.
COPY --chown=node:node --from=assets /wiki/package.json ./package.json
COPY --chown=node:node ./LICENSE ./LICENSE

USER node

VOLUME ["/wiki/data/content"]

EXPOSE 3000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
  CMD curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/healthz || exit 1

CMD ["node", "--no-deprecation", "server"]
